## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] New or changed engine behavior has tests in `tests/engine/`.
- [ ] Every new or changed text is in both `src/i18n/locales/en.json` and `es.json` (the parity test passes).
- [ ] The UI was checked in English and Spanish, and in the light and dark themes, if it changes.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`.
- [ ] The README files (English and Spanish) are updated if supported features change.
